description: Return the production current time payload for a single already-identified city, query, or IANA timezone. Do not use this for conversions, overlaps, or meeting search. If the city is unknown or could be more than one place, call search_timezones and retry with suggestedQuery or countryCode; do not guess. Exact country-name queries may be retried through a canonical city when the resolver can do so deterministically. For relative-date inputs ("Tuesday", "next Friday", "tomorrow", "tonight"), route to answer_time_question.

_endUserId.description: Optional opaque per-call end-user attribution token populated by the MCP host, not the LLM. Use a non-PII hash or token; never send raw email, name, or platform user ID.

candidateLimit.description: Page size for namesake candidates. Default 6. Follow moreCandidates.resolve or moreCandidates.search for the rest.

candidateOffset.description: Skip this many namesake candidates. Copy from moreCandidates.candidateOffset.

countryCode.description: Optional ISO country hint for ambiguous city names.

query.description: Free-form location query, country name, or timezone abbreviation.

name: get_current_time
